text:
Ella S.: Heads-up — Acme POC hit 429s and trace correlation gaps when they enable log export to Datadog. Mike says spikes when exporting >1000 events/s. Sharing a short snippet of the app logs below, can SRE + solutions triage? :eyes:

Mike (AcmeCorp): Seeing a steady stream of 429s after switching on the drain. Example from the app: 
```
2026-05-03T15:12:08Z error="rate limit exceeded" status=429 request_id=abcd-1234 trace_id=cd4f3a9b endpoint=/v1/logs
```

Ops Bot: Alert: export-backpressure detected for project `acme-poc` — 429 rate sustained at ~1200 rps (5m avg).

Rami K.: Can you paste the exact curl/producer config you're using to ship logs?

Mike (AcmeCorp): This is what our side is doing (running from k8s sidecar):
```
curl -X POST "https://export.redwood.com/v1/drain" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @batch.json
```
Batch.json is ~1200 events per payload.

Devon L.: Ok — payload size + concurrent writers explains the 429s. Two quick fixes: reduce batch size to ~400–500 and limit parallel uploads. Also add the trace header so exports include trace IDs for correlation: use header `X-Redwood-Trace` or standard `X-Request-ID`.

Jordan (SRE): On our side I noticed the export mapping didn't pick up forwarded trace headers for onprem drains. Need to set `trace_header` in export config. Example we can provide to Acme: 
```
{
  "destination": "datadog",
  "trace_header": "x-request-id",
  "batch_size": 500,
  "max_concurrent_exports": 4
}
```

Devon L.: Also toggle `enable_prefix_kv_cache=true` on their route to reduce duplicate event forwarding. That dropped similar spikes for another customer.

Kate (Security): Quick security note — logs contain PII (user.email, ip). Acme's Sec questionnaire requires masking before export. Suggest a pre-export filter example: 
```
jq 'del(.user.email, .user.ssn, .ip)' batch.json > scrubbed.json
```
We should send them a sanitization checklist for the POC.

Rami K.: For immediate mitigation I can patch their sidecar config and throttle the exporter. Also FYI for sales: exports during the POC are covered by our trial; if they go to Dedicated/Private we'll need to include egress in the quote.

Ella S.: Noted. I'll flag pricing to Acme — thanks. Mike, we'll cover the first week of exports in the POC.

Jordan (SRE): I applied a temporary customer-side rate cap on our export gateway: `export_rate_limit=800` for `acme-poc`. Monitoring link: https://console.redwood/internal/exports/acme-poc (internal).

Mike (AcmeCorp): Re-tested after lowering batch size + rate cap — 0 429s over the last 3m. Trace correlation now working, I can click from the log entry to the trace: trace_id `cd4f3a9b`. Thanks!

Kate (Security): I'll attach the answers to the security questionnaire in this thread (SAML support, KMS key rotation, SOC2 controls). Will also provide the sanitization scripts.

Ops Bot: Note: ticket #POC-984 updated — status `investigating` -> `mitigated` (owner Jordan).

Ella S.: Awesome. Next steps: Rami to send patched sidecar snippet + jq filter, Jordan to monitor for 24h, Kate to upload sec answers, I'll confirm pricing note with Acme. Mike — any other blockers? :thumbsup:

Mike (AcmeCorp): All good for now. Will ping if anything else pops up later today.

Ella S.: Great — closing the swarm for now, will reopen if we see new 429s. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
